request.raw_text: Use geometry of cylindrical hole defined in Sketch4 for creating inscribed hexagonal polygonal to the original hole and make it through all cutout instead.

aim.primary_aim: Replace the original cylindrical hole with a hexagonal cutout inscribed in its defining geometry and extending through the complete thickness.

functional_design_intentions.name: Through-all opening
functional_design_intentions.description: Provide a continuous hexagonal opening through the complete thickness instead of the original cylindrical hole.

targets_to_change.action: replace with inscribed hexagonal through-all cutout
targets_to_change.reference_geometry: original cylindrical hole geometry defined in Sketch4

required_relationships.reference: original cylindrical hole geometry defined in Sketch4
complete thickness intersected along the original hole direction

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its location and circular boundary as the reference governing the inscribed hexagon; do not preserve the cylindrical opening as final cutout geometry.

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: all geometry outside the requested hole replacement
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve non-targeted model geometry and dimensions under a minimum-change rule.

geometry.description: A six-sided polygonal cutout exists in place of the original cylindrical hole, is inscribed in the cylindrical-hole geometry defined in Sketch4, and extends through the complete thickness.

relationships.reference: original cylindrical hole geometry defined in Sketch4
complete thickness intersected along the original hole direction

functions.name: Provide through-all polygonal opening
functions.description: The final geometry provides a continuous hexagonal opening through the complete thickness.

behaviors.name: Permit passage through the complete thickness
behaviors.description: The cutout leaves no terminating material across its hexagonal opening through the affected thickness.

validation_criteria.description: The replacement cutout has exactly six polygon sides.
The hexagonal boundary is inscribed in the original cylindrical-hole geometry defined in Sketch4.
The hexagonal cutout extends through the complete intersected thickness.
The original cylindrical opening is replaced and is not the final cutout shape.
The hexagonal opening is continuous through the complete thickness.
No terminating material obstructs the requested hexagonal opening through the affected thickness.
Geometry outside the requested hole replacement remains unchanged.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not state whether Sketch4 contains more than one geometry element capable of defining the referenced cylindrical hole.
candidate_interpretations: Sketch4 contains a single circular definition corresponding to the original cylindrical hole.
The intended circular definition must be identified among multiple elements in Sketch4.

unresolved_requirements.description: The phrase 'inscribed hexagonal' is interpreted in its standard geometric sense, but the exact contact convention is not further stated.
candidate_interpretations: The six vertices of the hexagon lie on the original hole's circular boundary.
The hexagon is only required to remain within the original circular boundary.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request specifies a through-all extent but does not explicitly identify the extent direction or affected thickness.
candidate_interpretations: Use the original cylindrical hole direction and pass through the complete intersected thickness.
